reference_period: 2026-09 OSM snapshot, with source dates and historic height limits per part

stack.height_basis: Ledcor project page: 161m and four twisting boxes
stack.proportions_basis: Editable visual estimates after contractor photograph inspection; not construction dimensions

alberni.height_basis: City 2016 rezoning design height; not an as-built height survey
alberni.proportions_basis: M1 estimates from current OSM envelope plus three primary architect photos; façade/balcony details excluded

canada_place.shape_basis: Five OSM fabric footprints; paired tension peaks and sag inferred from SEABC 2017 Canada Place photographs, not structural form-finding
canada_place.vertical_basis: City2009 overlapping roof top elevations; regional CGVD28-to-CGVD2013 geoid conversion. City metadata calls heights geodetic without an explicit datum field, so CGVD28 is a recorded project assumption.

harbour_centre.basis: SEABC 2017 PDF page 27 shows a thin central mast. Width is an explicit M1 estimate. Current OSM deck and cap provide the 156 to 167 m connector end heights. Contradictory intermediate OSM part remains excluded.
